renderer: Official Blender 3.6.23 Linux x64, Cycles CPU, 2 threads, 16 samples, denoising, Standard view
whole: Original vertices and faces. Gray surface, red early faces, orange selected component.
detail: Isolate the selected connected component using original triangles; original measurements and ray. Other components hidden only for display.
measurements: Blue build endpoints; green heldout endpoints; octahedra are markers, not reconstructed geometry.
query_contract: All metrics and analytic slices use full original surfaces, irrespective of display isolation.
geometry_editing: No smoothing, remeshing or generated image content.
selection: Recorded in manifest and summary; independently selected median eligible failure per method, not matched actors.
files: <method>.blend contains full actor scene; <method>_detail.blend contains isolated chart scene.
runtime_note: Official binary includes OpenColorIO. Debian build with opencolorio=False produced invalid black renders; those were replaced before delivery.
